1.title: Day 1 · Ops Specs, op control, duty, study path
1.html:
Mon Sep 21, 2026 · CAE Dallas West

Dense capture from Plaud 01–06 (~208 min) + whiteboard. Ops Specs spine = A General · B Enroute · C Term · D Maint · E W&B (mnemonic: Get More Whiskey And Beer). Know where to find answers. Memory items + limitations = closed-book.

Praetor 500/600 track only. Phenom/Challenger appear as fleet types in Indoc overview — no Phenom shelves.

Must lock — Day 1

  • CTH first: ForeFlight Praetor 500/600 Crew Training Handbook (~80 pp) ≈ 99% of type prep (memory · limitations · systems Qs). CFM for flows/profiles/checklist usage. AFM later via Fly Embraer — don’t AFM-cram early.
  • Aircrew Training Manual: Flexjet Docs → Training & Checking → Instructor/Check Airman → ATM → type appendix (curriculum map).
  • Sunday 50Q: open-book on Flexjet Academy (iPad). Prep from ~201Q study guide. Gerald (135 mgr) writes wording gotchas.
  • Academy ~11 modules: Heather Bey assign · required for 135 credit · done by Sunday. academy.flexjet.com · Flexjet email · pw Flexjet1 (change first login). Issues → heather.bey@flexjet.com
  • Duty always 135: 14 duty / 10 fly / 10 rest (two-pilot). Tailwind tracks; speak up if reality breaks plan. Non-local deadhead ≠ rest.
  • Op control: company only initiates/conducts/terminates. Legal crew+aircraft+pax+flight. A006 names from class (verify spelling). Platinum Jet/Darby lesson.
  • Everest Fuel: contract FBO — sign ticket · gallons in Tailwind. Non-contract — release card; Multi-Service backup on aircraft. Report bad fueling. Tankering SW glitched — captain judgment.
  • Lower T/O mins: ~500 RVR (135) / ~600 (91K) class numbers — verify OpSpec. SIC 100-in-type to manipulate.
  • Ferry / FCF: OpSpec D permits in ForeFlight; not AD-grounded; Indoc qualifies many FCFs — call MX if unsure.
  • Pax ID / brief: 135 photo ID ≥18; prefer face-to-face over PA; seatbelt culture; Real ID / enhanced DL states named in class.
  • Food safety: keep cold; danger zone ~41–140°F; leftovers = give away/trash; never reheat twice.
  • D&A: 8-hr bottle-to-throttle; random via Safety; leave site = refusal; ≥0.04 path + FAA; meds via AME/company.
  • High-mins: no A+B pair; ~100 hrs high-mins; ~75 hrs B floor.
  • Priorities: Safety → Compliance → Customer service.
  • ASAP: both pilots file → company + FAA/POI. Not obligated to call ATC deviation phone if ASAP filed. No shield for intentional/careless/D&A.
  • Medical: first-class only; by 25th of expiration month. Spare glasses if required on medical. Temp type cert 120 days — chase plastic early.
  • FO: left seat; log SIC until designated captain; 100 hrs in type to manipulate controls (opspec — verify FOM).

Praetor study path (from Day 1)

  • Now: CTH memory items + limitations + callouts + normal takeoff/ILS flows from expanded CFM.
  • IPT / Systems Integration: free-play after hours if CAE customers aren’t using; paper-tiger poster in hotel.
  • Sims: ~6 + check · ~4h sessions · ~5h check. Scenario orals with cockpit poster — show switchology.
  • 500 vs 600: study as identical systems; match the SIM you are assigned.
  • Link facts into Praetor shelves as ground school fills them — empty systems OK until lecture says so.

Open items

  • Academy modules + Sunday 50Q prep
  • Fly Embraer / Embraer TechPub download · verify CTH in ForeFlight
  • Confirm RDA on training email (Day 2)
  • Everest Fuel 13:00 brief — captured Day 1 clip 04
  • Day 3 verify: OpSpec takeoff/alternate mins · FOM 7.3.11 icing · Praetor land-with fuel · “MPL” label
  • Day 4 verify: hazmat exception numbers on the card · COAST/PREP letters · Praetor emergency-descent items (QRH)
  • Confirm W&B save-vs-send SOP · POI spelling · official type-travel email

Daily encode loop

  1. Capture raw in class.
  2. Encode same night into A–E shelves + Praetor notes.
  3. Park fuzzy items on Admin checklist.
  4. Quiz: “Which opspec bucket?” before memorizing paragraph numbers.

2.title: Day 2 · Video day (light notes)
2.html:
Tue Sep 22, 2026 · Day 2 — video day

Lots of videos Day 2 — CFIT, runway incursions, wake turbulence, upset/stall, PRM/breakout-type. Skim/archive the videos. Do not dense-study video narration. Durable process below only.

Plaud 01–06 · ~229 min · LIGHT notes only. Praetor 500/600 track.

Must lock — Day 2

  • Military / PPR: civil landing permit on file · Flight Control obtains permission/PPR · permit copy to crew · originals with the pilot manager (verify FOM). Read Tailwind airport notes.
  • Praetor path: separate systems-integration week → ~6 sims + checkride + walk (ASR first said eight, then clarified). Challenger/Phenom combine ground + SI.
  • EFB: ForeFlight primary (plans/WX/NOTAMs/plates/charts/company docs). Download Embraer TechPub. MyFreeFlight still for W&B/runway-analysis exposure. iPad for all work assignments. EFB currency guide under Documents → resources.
  • RDA: access coming via training email (classmates got it Day 2) — confirm yours.
  • People: Jim Dunn (Director of Training) · David Cooper (managers / lead check airmen context).
  • Study: keep question-bank / study-guide lookups going (know sources for Sunday open-book).

3.title: Day 3 · MX forms, icing, duty/rest, mins, taxi CRM
3.html:
Wed Sep 23, 2026 · Day 3 — classroom dense

MX forms · CDL/ferry/MVF · ForeFlight W&B/performance · icing HOT/tactile · duty/rest/FOTM · status book/501 · takeoff/alternate mins · taxi CRM. Plaud 01–07 (~224.5 min; clips 02–03 non-speech).

Praetor 500/600 track. Classmate-safe process only — no personal PII. Verify live OpSpec/FOM numbers before checkride.

Must lock — Day 3

  • Form 501: never erase — line through · initial+date · rewrite. Error 501 → “generated in error / no MX.” Pink copy stays; no next flight until corrected/deferred.
  • Remote MX: approved video link · controller Form 500 + CAMP · fail → PIC writes 501.
  • CDL: back of MEL · performance penalties · stack with other deviations.
  • Ferry / MVF: MX inspect before ferry · FO-03 on board · no revenue · no post-accident ferry until NTSB/FAA release. Cat 1 MVF no MX sign-off; speak up on structural/flight-control ferries; no pax on required MVF/FCF unless needed.
  • Circuit breakers: no in-flight reset unless needed for safe flight; QRH-only pulls; ground OK.
  • Weigh: empty weight/CG every 36 months.
  • Icing: HOT advisory; contamination check still required. Inside HOT + visible → visual (~5 min prior). Exceed HOT → tactile required. Freezing drizzle/light freezing rain / can’t determine → tactile (FOM 7.3.11 — verify).
  • Contaminated landing: ~1.15 factor class · braking-action fair/nil advisories · stabilized Vref.
  • Performance: Part 135 baseline · ForeFlight primary · fail → AFM. Landing planning 60% rule; DAAP/80% path — verify live use.
  • W&B / fuel: Save to flight files. Bag ~30 lb class. Land-with targets class: ~2000 lb large-cabin / ~800 lb Phenom-Praetor class — verify Praetor FOM. Don’t abuse tankering.
  • Duty/rest: 14/10 baseline. >10 flight in 24h → table rest. FOTM may extend duty to max 15h two-pilot if beyond company control + realistically planned. Circadian low ~0130 local where duty begins (test item — confirm card). Hotel 90/120 standby.
  • Status book (FOM §5): PIC airworthiness every flight — tires, consumables, docs, open discrepancies. Aim ~90+ min early on day-one tight turns.
  • Takeoff/alternate mins: OpSpec tables. Dual operable RVR when vis <¼ SM / ~1600 RVR class + lighting. Takeoff alternate ≤1 hour still air if can’t return. Alternate weather from OpSpec approach table.
  • Taxi CRM: chart + brief before taxi · heads-up · verify crossings · stop for FMS programming · runway/departure change checklist after push.
  • Oral tip: limitations + memory items ≈ ~85% of oral (class).
  • Class B under shelf: 200 kt — controller cannot authorize faster.

People — Day 3

  • Mike Sliva — Indoc instructor (continuing)
  • Scott — co-instruct · icing/CRM/mins blocks
  • FOTM — duty extensions (max 15h two-pilot)

4.title: Day 4 · Hazmat, evacuation, physiology
4.html:
Thu Sep 24, 2026 · Day 4 — hazmat · evac · physiology

Hazmat (will-not-carry) · raft/ditching video · emergency evacuation · disabled passengers · service culture · altitude physiology. Plaud 01–05 (~145.6 min; clip 05 non-speech).

Praetor 500/600 track. Classmate-safe, generic takeaways only. Verify numbers against the written hazmat card / QRH before a checkride.

Must lock — Day 4

  • Hazmat: Flexjet is a will-not-carry operator. No hazmat authorization; only items that qualify as exceptions (company materials too). Training per 14 CFR 135.505, recurrent every 24 months.
  • Dry ice (test item): 5.5 lb per person (class). Alcohol: ≤1.3 gal, ≤70%. Self-defense spray: ≤4 oz with safety clip.
  • Lithium: spare batteries and vapes carry-on only. Mobility-aid Li battery ≤300 Wh; one spare, or two at ≤160 Wh. Terminals protected. PIC told where it is.
  • Hidden hazmat: ask what’s in the bag. Bleach, drain cleaner, pool chemicals, spray starch, fireworks, magnets = no. Fuel-engine gear only if fully purged. If it looks or smells wrong, don’t load it.
  • In-flight spill/fumes: consider emergency descent + landing · mask + smoke goggles · tell ATC.
  • Evac: PIC runs it (SIC if PIC can’t) · tell ATC early · look outside before opening any exit · sweep cabin · don’t re-enter · account for everyone. On the ramp, main cabin door is best.
  • TEST pax brief: Type of emergency · Exit to use · Signals (brace call) · Time to touchdown.
  • Raft: preflight inspection card + handles out + painter line clear (snag = inflation inside the cabin). From aircraft: tie painter line, throw away from aircraft, pull line. In water: quick-deploy ring. Never drink seawater. Whistle is the best voice you have.
  • Disabled pax: ask how to help · enlist able pax · don’t injure yourself · slow down, call EMS to help board.
  • PIC owns parking: don’t accept a ramp spot that’s unsafe for passengers (ice).
  • Service: call ahead so the car is planeside at shutdown · door to door · smile at the stairs · last thing they see is you closing the door.
  • Physiology: 61.31(g) high-altitude endorsement · hypoxia types: hypoxic / hypemic / stagnant / histotoxic · mask 100% early · DCS can appear hours later · use the Praetor QRH for emergency-descent memory items.
  • Devices: keep company and personal phone/email separate; use personal email for government/benefit accounts.

People — Day 4

  • Mike Sliva — Indoc instructor (continuing)
  • Scott — co-instruct · disabled-pax / service culture
